# Rear sway bar relocation and brake line check

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Check rear suspension droop, install a sway bar relocate kit for the axle mount if using a new leaf pack to prevent hitting the shock. [t466]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Check the full droop of the rear suspension before removing the sway bar.
2. [Partial] Install a relocate kit for the axle mount if using a new leaf pack to prevent hitting the shock.

_Procedure reported by [t466]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Check brake line length at full droop; extended lines or modifications may be needed even with a 2-inch lift. [t466]
